critique: The render strongly matches the Mapped Strings look: a black field filled with pale aqua particle strings, distinct dotted trails, dense fractal tangles, and clearly evolving geometry between t1 and t4. The main mismatch is tonal: the strings are very uniformly mint/white with frequent clipped-white knots, whereas the preset reference's mapped coloration is better represented by a more controlled cyan/teal range. The densest intersections also obscure some of the cleaner individual string paths.

suggestions.why: Lower maximum particle opacity to reduce blown-white intersections and restore readable dotted-string separation.
Shift the flattened fallback particle color toward a clearer cyan/teal so it better approximates the preset's mapped-color appearance.
